forbidden_strategy_inputs: existing strategy labels or pass/fail outcomes
permitted_existing_inputs: actual historical LP positions and cash flows

objective: derive the highest-repeatability after-cost DLMM strategy independently for each venue from market and operator evidence

venue_windows.meteora: minimum 120 days plus current complete market census; extend when API history supports it
venue_windows.ramses: entire Robinhood DLMM history from deployment through the study cutoff

segmentation.primary: empirical quantiles and interactions; do not preselect a preferred TVL/age/fee/width bucket
segmentation.interactions: cross-classify economically meaningful dimensions rather than selecting one variable at a time

validation.chronological_split: derive on earlier data; validate on later data; final holdout remains untouched until rule freeze
validation.operator_leakage_control: same wallet/fleet cluster may not supply independent support to both derivation and holdout
validation.minimum_independent_support: candidate behavior must recur across at least 3 independent operator clusters when operator data exists

outputs.final_comparison: Meteora and Ramses strategies are derived separately; similarity is not assumed
